subject: Next steps & trial playbook — SableCare discovery -> onramp
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Evan Ross <evan.ross@sablecare.com>, Maya Liu <maya.liu@sablecare.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Next steps & trial playbook — SableCare discovery -> onramp

Hi Evan / Maya,

Thanks again for the conversation today — really helpful to understand where SableCare is trying to get to. Quick recap and proposed onramp so we can lock calendars and owners: 

Summary of pain / goals we heard
- High latency and inconsistent throughput on current in-house LLM endpoints (esp. peek loads during billing window).
- Sensitive PHI-style inputs: primary requirement is VPC/private routing + KMS-managed keys.
- Need a cost predictability lever and easy failover to a lower-capacity model during spikes.

Pilot hypothesis / success metrics (30-day trial)
- Reduce 95th percentile latency from ~650ms to <=250ms for core inference route (batch size <=8).
- Demonstrate unit cost savings of at least 25% vs current baseline with caching + batching.
- No PII leakage: all logs routed to SableCare-managed audit bucket; redaction check passes automated eval.

Scope and artifacts I propose we deliver in the pilot
- Dedicated 2-week performance sprint: baseline capture, config tuning (batching/kv caching), and one quantized model variant for cost comparison.
- Prompt set & evals: we’ll run the 120-case prompt matrix you shared + 50 edge cases for hallucination/regression tracking.
- Access & infra: VPC peering, service account with least privilege, KMS key handshake, sample dataset (redacted) for load testing.

Owners & timeline
- SableCare: Evan (technical sponsor) + Maya (product).
- Redwood: Ben (sales lead) + Monica (CS/ops owner).
- Week 0 (this week): sign-off on mutual action plan and access window.
- Week 1: infra setup, baseline data capture.
- Weeks 2–3: tuning, prompt-evals, perf/quality comparison.
- Week 4: readout + recommendation, decision on expansion.

Action items (for next 72 hours)
1) Evan — confirm that legal can accept the standard pilot MSA (I’ll loop sales ops).
2) Maya — fill in the shared prompt matrix gaps (we flagged 12 missing edge-cases).
3) Ben/Monica — send the mutual action plan + access checklist (attached).
4) Schedule kickoff: propose Tue 9/7 10am ET (60 min). Please reply with availability.

Attachments (stubs): mutual_action_plan.xlsx, sablecare-pilot-charter.md, network-access-checklist.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Evan Ross <evan.ross@sablecare.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Liu <maya.liu@sablecare.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 14:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps & trial playbook — SableCare discovery -> onramp

Thanks Ben — useful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Legal/procurement: I’ve started a thread with procurement; they usually need a one-page SOW with timelines. If you can convert the mutual_action_plan.xlsx into a one-pager SOW that would speed things up.
- Data: we’ll provide a redacted sample set by Monday; network team requires the exact CIDR ranges for peering.
- Metrics: can you add an availability target (we’re aiming for >=99.5% during business hours) and a fallback plan if the dedicated pool is degraded?

We’re OK to target Tue 9/7 10am ET for kickoff, pending procurement. If procurement pushes back on pilot terms we may need a short commercial review call.

Evan

SableCare Health
evan.ross@sablecare.com | +1 (617) 222-1180

Thanks — absolutely. I’ve attached the mutual_action_plan.xlsx and a draft SOW one-pager in the Drive link. Key callouts: availability target at 99.6% during the pilot window (we can agree to 99.5% if that’s your internal target) and an automatic fallback policy that routes requests to a compatible, lower-capacity model variant with degraded SLA but preserved functional behavior.

I also added a short checklist for the network team (CIDRs + peering window suggestions) in network-access-checklist.pdf. Monica will handle the onboarding playbook once we have peering details.

I’ll convert the MSA/SOW language for procurement — looping Sales Ops now.

Ben

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Evan Ross <evan.ross@sablecare.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 09:17:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps & trial playbook — SableCare discovery -> onramp

Hi Evan / Ben,

Thanks — I’ll lead the ops side for Redwood. Quick notes from an onboarding perspective: 

Pre-kickoff checklist (I’ll own execution):
- Create service account + grant least-privilege roles (I’ll send a JSON sample for IAM).
- Create a temporary KMS key handshake; we support AWS KMS / GCP CMEK — which do you prefer?
- Validate SableCare audit bucket location & retention policy (we’ll push logs there).
- Confirm peering window: Tue 9/7 08:00–12:00 ET (preferred).

Pilot runbook highlights:
- Baseline capture: 24–48 hours of production-like traffic (we’ll throttle if needed).
- Eval cadence: daily regression checks, 3 planned smoke tests (day 2, day 7, day 21).
- Prompt-eval deliverable: scoring CSV + brief summary of hallucination/regression failures.

Please review the attached network-access-checklist.pdf and the shared Drive folder — I added a folder for the prompt matrix and a template for the SOW.

If procurement needs an NDA addendum or extra data-processing language, flag it and I’ll route to security/compliance.

Monica

Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0144

Ben / Monica — that all looks good. Procurement asked for the one-page SOW and a brief commercial note on trial costs/credits (they tend to include the latter before sign-off). Can you send an estimate of expected consumption and the credit level you offer for the 30-day pilot?

Maya and I confirmed Tue 9/7 10am ET for kickoff. I’ll add procurement and our network lead to the invite once I have the SOW.

I’ll upload the redacted sample data by end of day Monday.

Thanks,
Evan
